title: Page 3
content_zh:
「呵呵……说什么叨扰，我们燕族也是因为你们戚家，才能安稳地在山中过日子，不必担心生活的问题呀。」
燕族长赶紧你们先填填肚子，晚上再摆一顿丰盛的大餐替你接风洗尘。」
「感谢燕族长，无雍就恭敬不如从命了。」
一来到大厅内，稍事休息之后，戚无雍也不浪费时间，直接挑明他此次上燕云山的主要目的，打算早点办完事就能够早点走人。
他从行囊内拿出几疋绣工精细的丝绸锦缎，直接递到燕族长面前，族长的双眼顿时发亮，就像是见到珍贵的黄金一样。
「燕族长，这是无戚布庄所产的布料，就当是给族长的见面礼。」
「这……这怎么好意思呢？」
燕族长口中直说不好意思，但双手早就快速捧过布料，简直就是爱不释手。「让你们破费了，以后来时不需要如此大手笔……」
「燕族长，你能喜欢就好。」戚无雍嘴角微勾，看来他从二哥的布庄捞几疋上好布料来做门面是做对了，拿人手短，他就不信燕族长不答应帮他的忙。
「呵呵呵……喜欢呀，当然喜欢……」
燕族长毕竟也是见过世面的，当然知道戚无雍不可能平白无故送他如此珍贵的布疋，一定是有所求才是。
「正所谓无功不受禄，戚四公子，如果有什么事情我能够帮忙的，就请直说吧，当作是我还你的一份回礼。」
「燕族长，果然什么事情都瞒不过你呀。」戚无雍恭敬的再次对燕族长躬身行礼。「无雍正是有一事相求，希望族长能够鼎力相助。」
「果然是如此，你就说来听听吧。」
「其实是这样的……」
戚无雍便把无戚茶楼和醉茗居之间的事大略告诉燕族长，并希望他能提供稀世珍贵的茶种，让他们可以和醉茗居一较高下，可谁知道原本乐呵呵的燕族长表情却慢慢迟疑起来，像是有什么顾忌一样。
「燕族长，无雍的恳求其实就这么简单，不知道族长……能否帮忙呢？」
「这个嘛……」燕族长又是迟疑了一下，手中抚着珍贵的锦布舍不得放，简直是左右为难。「要不然这样好了，戚四公子，你先好好的在这休息住下，过几天我们再来谈这个问题，好吗？」
「呃？」就只是给个新茶种而已，有必要这样推三阻四，还使出了拖延大法？「燕族长，说实话，无雍急着想找到……」
「我知道、知道，就三天，三天之后给你答覆好吗？瞧你一身风尘仆仆的，我赶紧唤下人准备间房让你休息，睡饱了才有精神谈事情嘛，哈哈哈……」

不让戚无雍再有开口的机会，燕族长马上叫人把戚无雍一行人给领到客房去休息，自己则一溜烟马上不见了，这让他简直纳闷到了极点，不懂燕族长到底在搞什么鬼？
「啧！布都已经收了，还不吐出珍贵茶种？那个狡诈的老狐狸，就别逼我使出大绝招……」
第1章(2)
正当戚无雍想继续破口大骂时，窗外却突然传来有人敲击的声音，他纳闷地推开窗，就见两个陌生的小姑娘站在窗外，一个对着他含情脉脉，另一个则笑得太过灿烂，简直诡异到了极点。
他暗挑了下眉，心想这里的姑娘还真是大胆，居然堂而皇之就这么直接找上门来了。
「两位姑娘，有事吗？」
燕晓苗笑着代表发言。「我听到你和族长的谈话了，老实告诉你，族长是不会给你珍贵茶种的。」
近距离看到他，又是他已经洗去狼狈之后的模样，她才不得不认同燕茗所说的话，他长得真的很好看，族里的男子都比不过他。
但她一定要稳住，不能像燕茗一样看到他俊朗的模样就昏头了，要不然绝对坏事！
「为什么？」
「因为族里有规定，不能给。」
「不能给？这是什么原因？」
「原因不能说，不过嘛……我可以偷偷带你去找珍贵茶种。」
这下戚无雍倒是又挑了下眉，只觉得这位小姑娘的行为非常可疑。「为什么你要帮我，这可是会犯了你们族里的规矩，不是吗？」
「没办法，因为她……」燕晓苗戳戳身旁对着戚无雍发花痴的燕茗。「谁教我的好姊妹不忍心见到你失望，硬是要我想办法帮忙，要不然我也不想来蹚这趟浑水。」
「真的？」他的魅力真有这么大？才刚来没多久就瞬间迷倒了一个小姑娘？
只见燕茗卖力地点头，非常尽责地在扮演花痴角色好让戚无雍上当，虽然此时此刻的她……是真的在对戚无雍发花痴。
「那好吧。」虽然不知道这两个姑娘葫芦里到底在卖些什么药，戚无雍还是笑着回应，准备到时候再来见招拆招。「就麻烦姑娘带路了，戚某感激不尽。」
「呵呵呵……好说好说，其实我们燕族是非常好客的，这位公子就不需要多礼了……」
在朗朗笑声中，一抹算计的眼神隐隐浮现在燕晓苗脸上，看起来好古灵精怪，她瞧瞧身旁的燕茗，果然还是继续在发花痴，算了，不管这个笨蛋，反正还有她一个人是清醒的，这样就够了。

呵呵……戚家四公子，你就准备等着倒大楣吧！
燕云山，山环水绕，位于丛山深处，所以终年有云雾缭绕，近水的地方更是弥漫着浓雾，难分东西，看到太阳露脸的机会反倒不多。
坐在小舟上，慢慢往山内深处划去，戚无雍瞧着两岸群山耸立、烟雾缥缈的美丽景象，既是赞叹不已，却也有些担心，要是不小心在这迷了路，能不能走得回去可是个大问题，还是注意点的好。
「来来来，请注意喽！」船夫站在后头划桨，燕晓苗则站在小舟最前头，非常尽职的介绍沿岸风景。「现在在我右手边的小断崖叫做望夫崖，在燕云山上很有名喔，它还有一个非常凄美的故——」
「等等，燕姑娘。」戚无雍板着脸打断她。
「是，请说。」
「我们是来寻珍贵茶种，并不是来游山玩水的，你是不是搞错了？」
燕晓苗依旧笑着回答：「我当然知道戚公子是要来寻找珍贵茶种的，不过我们燕云山的风土民情你还是要知道一点嘛，要不然……」
「可以不需要这么麻烦，我就不信不听会少掉任何一根寒毛。」
「喔……这样啊……」燕晓苗也不恼，倒是不慌不忙地抽出一把油伞，唰地一声撑开伞面，姿势优雅漂亮。
紧接着唰的另一声，突然下大雨啦，毫无准备的戚无雍一行人马上在舟上被淋成了落汤鸡，再度狼狈凄惨不已。
「下雨啦下雨啦，四公子您要不要紧？我们赶紧帮您遮住……」
随行而来的保镳们忙着拿自己差不多要湿透的外衣想替戚无雍挡雨，简直是可笑极了，雨遮不了多少，倒是让戚无雍更显狼狈而已。
直到这时，燕晓苗才继续说：「听说之前有个年轻妻子站在这座崖上等待远行的丈夫回来，但这里三不五时就会下起大雨，年轻妻子又死守着不肯离开，最后居然被雨淋到冷死了，所以长辈们都会特别告诫，来这里，绝对要撑伞。」
笑咪咪的瞧着满脸阴郁的戚无雍，燕晓苗再度询问：「戚公子，现在你觉不觉得，还是需要知道一些我们的风土民情比较好？」
content_en:
"Haha... What are you talking about? It's because of your Qi family that our Yan clan can live peacefully in the mountains without having to worry about life problems."
Chief Yan, hurry up and fill your stomachs first, and then prepare a sumptuous meal for you in the evening. "
"Thank you to Patriarch Yan. Wu Yong is more respectful than obedient."
As soon as he arrived in the hall, after taking a short rest, Qi Wuyong did not waste time and directly pointed out the main purpose of his trip to Yanyun Mountain this time, intending to finish his work early and leave early.
He took out several pieces of finely embroidered silk brocade from his luggage and handed them directly to the Yan clan leader. The clan leader's eyes suddenly lit up, as if he had seen precious gold.
"Clan Chief Yan, this is the fabric produced by Wuqi Cloth Village. Think of it as a meeting gift for the clan leader."
"This...how is this so embarrassing?"
Chief Yan said he was sorry, but he quickly held the cloth with both hands and simply couldn't put it down. "I've spent a lot of money on you, so you don't need to be so generous in the future..."
"Clan Chief Yan, it's good if you like it." Qi Wuyong's lips curled up slightly. It seemed that he did the right thing by grabbing a few pieces of good fabric from his second brother's cloth shop to make a facade. If someone was short-handed, he didn't believe that Chief Yan wouldn't agree to help him.
"Hehehe... I like it, of course I do..."
After all, Patriarch Yan has seen the world, and of course he knows that Qi Wuyong cannot give him such a precious cloth for no reason. He must be asking for something.
"As the saying goes, no reward comes without merit. Mr. Qi, if there is anything I can do to help, please just tell me. Consider it a return gift from me."
"Clan Chief Yan, I can't hide anything from you." Qi Wuyong respectfully bowed to Chief Yan again. "Wu Yongzheng has something to ask for, and I hope the clan leader can help me."
"As expected, just tell me and listen."
"Actually, it's like this..."
Qi Wuyong told Chief Yan roughly what happened between Wuqi Teahouse and Zui Mingju, and hoped that he could provide rare and precious tea species so that they could compete with Zui Mingju. However, who knew that the originally cheerful Chief Yan's expression gradually became hesitant, as if he had some scruples.
"Clan Chief Yan, Wu Yong's request is actually that simple. I wonder if the Patriarch... can help?"
"Well..." Chief Yan hesitated again, stroking the precious brocade cloth in his hand and reluctant to let it go. He was in a dilemma. "Otherwise, this is better. Mr. Qi Si, you can take a good rest here first, and we will discuss this issue again in a few days, okay?"
"Huh?" It's just a new tea species. Is it necessary to push back and forth like this and use delaying methods? "Clan Chief Yan, to be honest, Wuyong is anxious to find..."
"I know, I know, it's only three days. I'll give you an answer in three days, okay? You look like you're so dusty, so I quickly called my servants to prepare a room for you to rest. Only when you're full will you have the energy to talk about things, hahaha..."
Not giving Qi Wuyong another chance to speak, Patriarch Yan immediately asked someone to take Qi Wuyong and his party to the guest room to rest. He disappeared immediately. This made him extremely puzzled. He didn't understand what Patriarch Yan was doing.
"Tsk! You've already collected the cloth, and you still haven't spit out the precious tea seeds? That cunning old fox, please don't force me to use my ultimate trick..."
Chapter 1(2)
Just when Qi Wuyong wanted to continue to curse, there was a sudden knocking sound outside the window. He opened the window in confusion and saw two strange little girls standing outside the window. One looked at him affectionately, and the other smiled too brightly, which was extremely weird.
He secretly raised his eyebrows, thinking that the girl here was really bold, and she came to her door so openly.
"Girls, are you okay?"
Yan Xiaomiao smiled and spoke on behalf of the group. "I heard the conversation between you and the clan leader. To tell you the truth, the clan leader will not give you treasure.Expensive tea. "
Seeing him up close, and seeing his appearance after he had washed away his embarrassment, she had to agree with what Yan Ming said. He was really good-looking, and none of the men in the clan could compare to him.
But she must be steady and not be like Yan Ming who gets dizzy when she sees his handsome appearance, otherwise it will definitely be a bad thing!
"Why?"
"Because the clan has regulations, we can't give it."
"Can't give it? What's the reason?"
"I can't say the reason, but... I can secretly take you to find precious tea seeds."
Qi Wuyong raised his eyebrows again, feeling that this little girl's behavior was very suspicious. "Why are you helping me? This would violate the rules of your clan, wouldn't it?"
"There's nothing I can do about it, because she..." Yan Xiaomiao poked Yan Ming, who was looking at Qi Wuyong in an infatuated manner. "Who taught me that my good sister couldn't bear to see you disappointed, so she insisted that I find a way to help, otherwise I wouldn't want to take a trip into this muddy water."
"Really?" Is he really that charming? Not long after you arrived, you instantly fell in love with a little girl?
I saw Yan Ming nodding hard, playing the role of a nympho very conscientiously so that Qi Wuyong would be fooled, although at this moment she... was really nymphomaniacal towards Qi Wuyong.
"Okay then." Although he didn't know what kind of medicine these two girls were selling, Qi Wuyong still responded with a smile, preparing to show off again when the time came. "I'll just ask you, girl, to lead the way. I'm very grateful to Qi."
"Hehehe... It's easy to say. In fact, our Yan tribe is very hospitable. This young master doesn't need to be more polite..."
Amid the loud laughter, a calculating look faintly appeared on Yan Xiaomiao's face. She looked so weird. She looked at Yan Ming next to her and saw that she was still having a nymphomaniac. Forget it, regardless of this fool, she was the only one who was awake anyway. That was enough.
Haha... Fourth Young Master of the Qi family, just be prepared to suffer a big loss!
Yanyun Mountain is surrounded by mountains and water. It is located deep in the mountains, so there are clouds and fog all year round. The area near the water is filled with thick fog, making it difficult to distinguish between east and west, and there are not many opportunities to see the sun.
Sitting on the small boat and paddling slowly deep into the mountains, Qi Wuyong looked at the beautiful scenery of towering mountains and misty smoke on both sides of the bank. He was filled with admiration, but also a little worried. If he accidentally got lost here, whether he could walk back was a big problem, so he had better pay attention.
"Come on, come on, please pay attention!" The boatman stood behind and paddled, while Yan Xiaomiao stood at the front of the boat, dutifully introducing the scenery along the coast. "The small cliff on my right is called Wangfu Cliff. It is very famous on Yanyun Mountain. It also has a very sad story——"
"Wait a minute, Miss Yan." Qi Wuyong interrupted her with a straight face.
"Yes, please say."
"We are here to find precious tea seeds, not to travel around. Are you mistaken?"
Yan Xiaomiao still smiled and replied: "Of course I know Mr. Qi is here to look for precious tea seeds, but you still need to know a little bit about our customs and customs in Yanyun Mountain, otherwise..."
"You don't need to go to such trouble, I don't believe you will lose any hair if you don't listen."
"Oh...that's it..." Yan Xiaomiao was not annoyed, but calmly took out an oil umbrella and opened it with a swish, with an elegant and beautiful posture.
Immediately after another swishing sound, it suddenly started raining heavily. The unprepared Qi Wuyong and his party were immediately soaked in the water on the boat, and they were once again embarrassed and miserable.
"It's raining, it's raining. Fourth Young Master, are you okay? We'll help you cover it quickly..."
The accompanying guards were busy trying to protect Qi Wuyong from the rain with their almost soaked coats. It was simply ridiculous. The rain could not cover much, but it only made Qi Wuyong look even more embarrassed.
Until then, Yan Xiaomiao continued: "I heard that there was a young wife standing on this cliff waiting for her husband to return from a long journey.Come, but it will rain heavily here from time to time, and the young wife refuses to leave. In the end, she is caught in the rain and freezes to death. Therefore, the elders will specially warn that you must hold an umbrella when you come here. "
Looking at the gloomy Qi Wuyong with a smile, Yan Xiaomiao asked again: "Mr. Qi, do you think it would be better to know something about our customs now?"
